framework: DPDP Act 2023 Section 8(5) Technical & Organizational Security Measures

encryptionAtRest.standard: AES-256 transparent data encryption (TDE) on PostgreSQL & S3
encryptionAtRest.keyManagement: AWS KMS with automatic key rotation

authenticationAndCredentials.apiKeys: 256-bit CSPRNG Base64URL unpadded (43 chars) with SHA-256 constant-time hash comparison

accessControlAndTenantIsolation.rowLevelSecurity: PostgreSQL RLS enabled on all sensitive application and demographic tables

rateLimitingAndDenialOfService.burstProtection: Local token-bucket in-memory burst limiter (60 to 3,000 req/min)
rateLimitingAndDenialOfService.durableLedgerQuota: Authoritative monthly ceiling check in PostgreSQL saas_usage_ledger

loggingAndAudit.privacyPreservingLogs: Zero raw passwords, API key secrets, or voter identity numbers in log streams
loggingAndAudit.auditTrail: Dedicated moderation_actions and immutable audit_log tables
